quotes.speaker: Speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of an anti-inflammatory diet for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I am on an anti-inflammatory diet. It has helped my body to become leaner while I am gaining muscle.
quotes.quote: As y'all know, I am on an anti-inflammatory diet. This diet has helped my body to become leaner while I am gaining muscle and taking a lot of the inflammation out of my body. As basketball players, one thing that we always have is sore knees and stuff like that. Throughout the whole summer, throughout the workouts, how hard I have been working, I really haven't had like sore knees or anything like that. So I feel like this diet has definitely been helping me out.

text_blocks.text: What are you looking most for from the Chicago Bulls this year?
